description: Kujiondoa kwa kuelekezwa kwa NumLookup, ambalo huorodhesha watu kwa nambari ya simu. Kujiondoa mara moja kunajumuisha kila nambari iliyohifadhiwa.
instructions: Fungua https://www.numlookup.com/opt_out, enter one of these numbers, finish the robot check and choose to remove your information: {all_phones}. Choose to send a removal request by hand (you don't need an account) and fill in {full_name}, {contact_email} and the number. The form may ask for a photo ID. You can black out everything on it except your name and photo. Kisha bonyeza "Nimefanya hili".
